tei:div.tei:p: bsang brngan mchod pa'i spyan 'dren gyi khang bzang gtor tshul ni/ bsang gzhung bang rim zlum po sum brtsegs steng*/ smin gling bla gtor pad 'dab bzhi pa/ spar btab ci 'dzoms kyis bskor/ dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron la lha bshos brgya/ mgon po yon tan mgron la dmar gtor brgya/ rigs drug snying rje'i mgron la ril bu brgya/ bgegs rigs lan chags mgron la glud gtor brgya/ chang bu brgya/ dgra lha dmar gtor dpung rong*/ 'khor bzhi/ mtheb skyu bcu gsum brtan ma bcu gnyis bshos bu dmar po'i rtser snying thur btsugs pa bcu gnyis/ dkar bgegs/ chad brtan/ tshogs/ gsol ka la ma mgon lcam dral 'bul gtor/ phud skong la bshos bu stod zur can dmar po drug legs ldan dmar gtor/ tshogs bdag dmar gtor/ gza' g.yas gcus/ gnod sbyin dmar gtor/ srog sgrub dmar gtor/ tshe ring bshos dkar/ g.yu sgron bshos dkar/ rnam sras bshos dkar/ ngan ne dmar gtor/ tse dmar dmar gtor/ dgongs btsan dmar gtor/ gser skyems bshos dkar/ gter mdzod gtor bsngos la dam can spyi gtor/ dpal yul gzhi bdag yongs rdzogs la gtor ma zur gsal rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na dkar gtor/ ja bdud shin tu mang po/ de nang mchod rgyu bshos bu sum cu/ rnam lnga spar btab sum cu/ ril bu sum brgya/ chang phud/ 'o phud chu phud/ bsang rtsam nang 'bru sna/ shing thog ja mar/ chang*/ chang zan dum bu mang po bcas/ dkar mo lag g.yas/ mda' dar bcas 'du byas la/ 'don 578) 'grigs ni/ sems bskyed sdom chog nas/ rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bsnyen bstod yig brgya yan/ bsang gzhung gi hrīḥ rang nyid hrīḥlas= lhug 'don/ ārya lo ki/ hrīḥ snang srid rnam dag= lhug bhyo bi sho= gsum/ mchod gzungs zhi rol/ rgya/ dung/ dkar/ hrīḥ snang srid dag pa= lhug chen por gsalaḥ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ thing*/ zil/ (Musical notes and signs here) kye/ byang chub snying po sangs rgyas dngaḥ

'phags pa'i bden pa dam pa'i chos/ rig grol gnyis ldan= des 'gres bsang 'don gyis/ 'di nas mtshams rnams la bsang phye theb gang re bsang du 'bul/ mchod pa rgya mtshos brnganaḥ nas gong ltar/ 'o/ khyad par sgron ma'i= bsang 'don kho nas/ mtshams rol mo bsang rdung zer ba dgu rdung rkyang pa de kho na yin/ mtshams/ sa yi lha mo sa 'dzin= khyad par byang phyogs gangs ri'i= mdor na mnga' ris skor gsum= rnams kyi mgor mtshams rol re/ mtshams rol thams cad la/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar bcas yod/ med par deng khug cig nas/ sil/ bzhag rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ 'og gi phud skong*/ brngan sbyin rgya mtsho'i/ sngags drug/ phyag drug swa bhā wa= stong pa'i ngang las= arghaṃ= dkar/ rgya/ dung*/ thing*/ sil/ (Musical notes and signs here) hūm̐ḥ 'og min stug po= bsang 'don kho nas/ 'di la 579) theb tu bshos bu gcig rnam lnga gcig ril bu bcu/ bsang phye phud bcas mtshams rol la bsang du 'bul/ (Musical notes and signs here) dngos grub stsolaḥ 'di man la/ theb gang bshos bu gnyis/ ril bu nyi shu/ bsang tsam phud bcas mtshams rol thams cad la mchod dgos pa 'gres shes par bya la/ mtshams rol kyang de kho na ltar yin/ kha 'bud/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ bcas thams cad la yod/ mtshams rol dgos pa'i tshig mgo rnams ni/ mar me mdzad dang= bya spyod rnal 'byor= nag mo khros ma= de las thub pa'i= khyad par lho rgyal= gzhan yang srid pa= khyad par lha sras= mdo smad hor dang= gzhan yang rgyal po'i= gling bzhi'i mi yi= gzhan pa dud 'gro'i= zhe sdang las gyur= gzhan yang 'khor ba= gzhan yang chu klung= bcas la mtshams rol dang*/ lhu tha ma 'di la/ bshos bu gcig rnam lnga gcig ril bu bcu rnams 'bul zhing*/ gzhan yang glo bur= brnyes par shog sil/ bzhag rol/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ de nas gsol ka yongs rdzogs/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyi/ yan/ (Musical notes and signs here) 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/

sil/ rgya/ dung*/ dkar/ (Musical notes and signs here) kye/ dang po dgra lha gang nas byung*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i lha yin te/ pho lha mo lha= dgra lha 'don/ des 'gres/ phud dang bsang phye 'bul/ (Musical notes and signs here) lha rgyal lo/ (Musical notes and signs here) 580) kyai/ yul ni bal bod mtshams shed na/ ma rig las byung wi ba lug khyim dang*/ brtan ma'i 'don rta sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i gtum chen dus mtha' dang 'dra/ brtan ma 'di rnams la bsang tsam theb re'i steng*/ rten gtor rtse'i snying gsum re thur ma bcas blangs la bzhag pa dang*/ phud bcas mtshams rol re re bzhin 'bul/ lhu gsum re'i mtshams/ (Musical notes and signs here) phud dang wi ba gtor mas brngan/ nas/ 'o/ yul ni 'brog chen= des 'gres/ yul ni 'brog chen= btsan la/ 'khrug rtsod zhi ba med par mdzod/ nas/ 'dir dpal yul gzhi bdag rnams bsang 'don mtshams rol can kho nas rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ kye/ gnas chen kaḥthog= sogs/ ye rang legs pa'i blo gros bsang*/ dgu rdung gis/ hūm̐/ ri rgyal lhun po'i= dgra lha'i 'don rtas/ khyad par g.yang can= mgor/ 'tshams rol gcig bkra shis rtsolaḥ nas/ zil/ bzhag rol/ 'di yan bsang gi rnga rdung*/ thams cad dkar/ rgya/ dung bcas thams cad la dgos/ de mtshams rigs 'dus tshogs byin rlabs lhag ma yan/ de nas/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ dgra lha lhug 'don gyis tshar grangs bsag tshar dus/ sum gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ rgya/ dkar dung*/ bsang bkyags tshul/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ ma hā ka la ya shā sa na= sngags bsngos lan gsum/ thing gsum/ sil/ sum gnyis/ hūm̐/ skad gcig dran rdzogs= bla ma yi dam= 581) tshangs pa mgrin sngon= ye shes las grub= kun bzang zhi khro= thub pa'i bstan pa= sangs rgyas bstan srung= sum gcig sil/ bzhag rol/ rgya/ dung*/ rkang gsum/ gtor ma thams cad bsang du 'bul/ shṝḥdharma pā la= thing gcig dung*/ sil/

bzhag sngon tshe o rgyan= na mo/ bdag gi= ma 'byor pa dang= yig brgya/ khyed kyis sems can= bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i gdangs kyis/ sems can gang dag= sho lo ka gsum/ zhi rol/ rgya/ dkar/ dung*/ rkang*/ thing gcig (Musical notes and signs here) sum gnyis/ rig 'dus bskul pa/ chad/ brtan/ bro/ mchod bstod bshags/ dngos grub/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis bcas bya'o// 'di'i gtor ma bsdu na/ mgron bzhi ya zung tsam/ gsol ka spyi bsdus tsam bya/ dge'o// 582)
